summary: Feb 2026 batch (Iteration 11) backend validation. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_feb2026.py — 15 tests covering Product Variants (PUT persistence, GET, sale variant pricing, invalid variant rejection, notes truncation), White-Label merchant fields (PUT/GET), Branding endpoints (by-slug 200/404, current for Super Admin & Vendor), Subscription enforcement (suspend blocks vendor login with EXACT Indonesian message → restore allows login), and Feature Toggles (GET defaults shape, POST matrix persistence, Admin 403). All 15/15 PASSED. Regression: test_iteration10_new_features.py 25/25 PASSED when run sequentially (-n 0). One test needed a fix: variant-pricing assertion incorrectly expected auto 10% tax; server logic accepts client-sent tax=0 within tolerance (0 ≤ client ≤ computed*1.05), so total=subtotal when client sends 0. Fixed to expect total==subtotal==40000. Autouse fixture guarantees m-barista.subscription_status='active' is restored before and after the module regardless of failure.

minor.issue: Server accepts client-supplied tax if 0<=tax<=computed*1.05, so a client can bypass 10% PB1 by sending tax=0. Not a variant-pricing bug (subtotal is server-authoritative) but tax bypass is a pricing loophole worth reviewing per business policy.

server.py line 542 branches `if data.get('features_enabled') is None and 'features_enabled' in data:` — because model_dump(exclude_unset=True) drops None-valued fields unless explicitly sent, this branch rarely fires. Not a functional bug; harmless dead-ish code.

TestShiftLock and TestCashOpname both mutate the single 'kasir' user's active shift; with -n 2 --dist loadscope these two classes run on different workers → race → intermittent failures. Passes fully with -n 0. Consider marking them same xdist_group or using per-test kasir accounts.

action_items: Consider whether client-supplied tax=0 should be accepted or always overridden with computed tax (SEC-005 partial coverage — subtotal is authoritative but tax isn't).
Add xdist_group marker (or serialize) for TestShiftLock+TestCashOpname to avoid intermittent parallel failures.
Optional: expose feature_toggles under BOTH /api/feature-toggles and /api/settings/feature-toggles (current path avoids conflict with parameterized /api/settings/{key}, confirmed correct).
critical_code_review_comments: create_sale variant lookup uses `v.get('active', True)` — a variant with active=False will be REJECTED (raises 'Varian tidak valid'). Confirm this is desired; today's tests don't cover an inactive variant path.

branding_by_slug returns 403 with the Indonesian message when merchant is suspended — good; but branding_current does NOT raise 403 for suspended vendor (only login enforces it). Vendor already logged in with a valid JWT before suspension keeps working until token expires. If instant lockout is required, add a subscription check inside current_user() as well.

MerchantInput default `subscription_status='active'` in Pydantic model means every PUT without that field will overwrite existing status with 'active' UNLESS model_dump(exclude_unset=True) drops it — and it does since Pydantic v2 exclude_unset only omits fields NOT explicitly passed. Verified safe with test_iteration11 payload (partial updates preserve slug/logo when the field is omitted). Nevertheless the wide MerchantInput schema with all-default fields is footgun-prone for future PATCH-style calls.
server.py is 1813 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Split into routers/{auth,products,sales,merchants,settings,branding}.py to improve maintainability.

Product variants JSON column is not wrapped with MutableDict; PUT re-assigns the whole list so it works, but any future in-place variant mutation will hit the same bug fixed in iter10 for bank-accounts. Prefer flag_modified pattern or MutableList.
test_credentials: Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Vendor merchant m-barista subscription_status was toggled during subscription tests and RESTORED to 'active' by module autouse fixture and verified via curl.
seed_data_creation: Left in DB: (a) product p-1 now has two variants Panas(18k) and Ice(20k); (b) merchant m-barista has slug=barista-test-<hex>, logo_url/theme_color(#00A86B)/banner_url/receipt_header/receipt_footer/wifi_password set, features_enabled.self_order=false; (c) subscription_status restored to 'active'. Feature toggle matrix reset to {} at end of tests. Several TEST_ prefixed sales exist for kasir Meja TEST_VAR/BAD_VAR/NOTES.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter11 alone or with -n 0 to avoid xdist collisions with iter10. Vendor merchant m-barista may have leftover slug/theme from white-label test — restore with PUT if needed. Feature-toggles endpoint is /api/feature-toggles (not /api/settings/feature-toggles). Subscription enforcement message must be EXACT 'Masa Langganan/Kerjasama Toko Telah Berakhir. Silakan Hubungi Platform Owner.' — Indonesian, includes period.
